cohort: Pregnant women who experienced arrested acute preterm labour, evidenced by a 12-hour contraction-free period.
finding: Vaginal micronized progesterone following arrested pre-term labor significantly increased the duration to delivery interval, reduced the recurrence of preterm labour, and decreased the rate of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean sections were significantly higher in the progesterone group (57.1%) compared to the control group (34.3%).
followup_time: Till 37 completed weeks of gestation or delivery
gest_age: Participants experienced preterm labour; delivery gestational ages ranged from 34-40 weeks.
